notes: §1985:XIII.3.17.2 prints '[SIGN IS] {LEADING | TRAILING} SEPARATE CHARACTER' (CHARACTER optional), and 'When the SIGN clause is included in a report group description entry, the SEPARATE CHARACTER phrase must be specified' (§1985:XIII.3.17.3 SR3), the signs being '+' and '-' (§1985:XIII.3.17.4 GR3 c). The shared signClause parses SEPARATE as optional and DataBinder.ScreenReportSignClauses, called from BindReportEntry's run, refuses at 85 a report SIGN clause without SEPARATE (COBOL0900, ReportSignWithoutSeparate2002, the witness) and one on a group entry (ReportGroupSign2002); SignClauseElementaryDefect refuses an unsigned, alphanumeric or edited subject and a COMP one (COBOL2422). Probes at 85: SIGN IS LEADING SEPARATE CHARACTER '-012', LEADING SEPARATE '-012', TRAILING SEPARATE CHARACTER '012-', +7 '007+', zero '+000', S9V99 '-200', SPP9 of -0.005 '-5', S9(18) '-123456789012345678', a SUM counter '00024-'; SIGN LEADING / TRAILING alone and a group SIGN COBOL0900 (accepted at 2023), SIGN written twice COBOL2423, SIGN IS / SIGN SEPARATE parse errors.

next.reason: 1985: "[SIGN IS] {LEADING|TRAILING} SEPARATE CHARACTER"; 2023: "[ SIGN IS ] {LEADING|TRAILING} [ SEPARATE CHARACTER ]". The 1985 Report Writer format requires SEPARATE CHARACTER. The 2023 format makes it optional and allows SIGN in report group entries, with no candidate requiring SEPARATE there.
